query:
SELECT p.title, t.name as tag_name, pt.projectId, pt.tagId
FROM projects p
JOIN projectTags pt ON p.id = pt.projectId
JOIN tags t ON pt.tagId = t.id
WHERE p.slug = 'the-glass-menagerie'
ORDER BY t.name;
